description: This file defines the VideoOutputPort class and its nested Display class, including member variables, methods, and related includes, serving as a stub for unit testing within the device settings module.

classes.name: VideoOutputPort
classes.description: Class extending Enumerable to represent a video output port with properties like type, resolution, display info, and methods for configuration and status.

classes.name: VideoOutputPort::Display
classes.description: Nested class representing display-specific information such as product code, serial number, physical address, and capabilities.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::getInstance
methods.description: Static method returning a singleton instance of VideoOutputPort, either default or by name.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the video output port.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the port.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the port.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::getDisplay
methods.description: Returns display information associated with the port.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::isContentProtected
methods.description: Indicates if content protection is enabled.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::isDynamicResolutionSupported
methods.description: Indicates if dynamic resolution is supported.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::setAudioPort
methods.description: Sets the associated audio port ID.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort::setResolution
methods.description: Sets the resolution with optional persistence and ignore EDID flag.
